flags.description: Break Free From Plastic's annual global brand audits have repeatedly named PepsiCo among the world's top plastic polluters for several consecutive years, based on volunteer-collected plastic waste counts across dozens of countries.

A 2016 report by Rainforest Action Network, OPPUK, and the International Labor Rights Forum documented child labor, hazardous pesticide exposure, and below-minimum-wage pay on Indonesian palm oil plantations supplying PepsiCo through its partner Indofood; PepsiCo suspended sourcing from Indofood in 2018 pending progress on the issues.
